constraints: Implementation is authorized only within the scope admitted by a future admission warrant; any expansion requires a separate proposed and admitted plan.

One primitive and one relation. The primitive is a retained digest of an invocation's textual output. The relation is invocation-to-artifact produced_by, established by recomputation rather than trusted from the seed.
No traversal. Composing this relation with the ContextManifest edge from PLAN-20260817-0001 to obtain invocation-to-invocation ancestry is deliberately out of scope, even though it becomes possible.

No retrofit. The 106 existing seeds stay relation_source future_edge_seed and authoritative false. Their records have no output digest, and model name, text_chars, timing and session id are consistency checks that do not bind an output.
The evaluator derives the established relation from evidence and does not read the seed's authoritative flag. The seed names the candidate to check.
Every check ships with its constructed falsifying input and observed result, per DECISION-20260812-0002, and each guard is mutation-tested.
No new predicate. The registry defines produced_by with inverse produces, not emitted in Slice A; the ancestry direction is that inverse and needs no second emitted predicate.
created_from: GAP-0008 recommended first slice, as restated after the produced_by measurement
expected_outputs: An output digest retained in the InvocationRecord outcome block, over the exact textual output the provider returned.

A pure function that, given a comparison artifact and a captured InvocationRecord, reports whether the artifact's response attributed to that record recomputes to the record's retained output digest, and returns unresolved with an enumerated reason wherever it cannot establish it.
A change to scripts/compare_providers.py sufficient to retain the digest and to make the response section attributable to a specific record.
A test file implementing the falsification set below.
At least one established invocation-to-artifact produced_by relation derived from evidence rather than from the seed.
A verification record and a capability amendment.
mitigation: The attribution problem is solved by the model line rather than the heading, because the heading is a provider display name and the mapping to an executor reference exists only in code. If the model line proves insufficient, the alternative is to name the invocation id in the response section, which is a larger artifact-format change and must be recorded rather than taken silently.

The digest is computed over the same text the artifact incorporates, obtained from the same value, rather than from a second reconstruction of what was returned. A separate approximation would create the class of false check that took three attempts to remove from the ContextManifest slice.
Adding a required field to the outcome block would invalidate the 28 records that carry one. The digest is therefore optional, and its absence yields unresolved rather than a failed validation.
next_action: Operator adjudication, then an admission warrant, then implementation.
non_goals: Invocation-to-invocation ancestry and any traversal that would compose two edge classes.
Promoting any seed by flipping authoritative from false to true.

EDGE record persistence. Whether established relations are derived on demand or written as EDGE records follows the truth condition rather than preceding it, and the EDGE validator does not currently admit produced_by.
Content-addressed output-to-effective-input linkage. This slice builds the primitive that would enable it and does not implement it.
Any change to the 34 pre-provenance comparison artifacts, which have no invocation records to attribute to.
notes: This plan exists because a measurement inverted its author's expectation. The packaging executor found 106 governed produced_by seeds and read that as making produced_by the cheap next slice. The reviewing executor asked what would make a seed authoritative and established that the seeds assert the relation without retaining evidence to reconstruct it, which makes output digesting the prerequisite rather than the alternative. The packaging executor verified the load-bearing claim before accepting it: INV-8419d4bb8a312acc carries no output digest, and its text_chars of 335 agrees with the artifact's 335-character response, which looks like corroboration and is satisfied by any string of that length.

Response attribution was measured at commit 0f8b594 before this scope was written. All 106 seeded artifacts carry exactly two response sections, each with a model line. The seed is artifact-level and does not say which response came from which invocation. The heading carries a provider display name, OpenAI or Claude; the record carries an executor reference, gpt-5.6-terra or claude-sonnet-5; and nothing retained maps one to the other. Attribution by heading would work today by coincidence and break silently on a provider rename or a third provider, which is why success criterion 8 falsifies it explicitly.

The packaging executor's cost estimates in this area have been wrong three times: C10 as the cheapest manual-mode constraint, reask_from_synthesis as the first directional edge, and produced_by as cheaper than output digesting. Each was corrected by the reviewing executor with a reproducible falsification. This plan's scope rests on measurements taken before it was written rather than on an estimate.
objective: Retain a digest of each invocation's textual output, and establish one invocation-to-artifact produced_by relation by recomputation rather than by assertion.
proposed_change: The outcome block added under DECISION-20260810-0001 carries stop_reason, stop_reason_field, input_tokens, output_tokens, content_block_types and text_chars, and no content digest. The 106 comparison artifacts carrying invocation_produced_by therefore assert a relation that cannot be reconstructed from the two endpoints: an evaluator can confirm the record exists and that text_chars agrees with the response length, and agreement on a length is satisfied by any string of that length. This slice adds the digest, makes the response section attributable to a specific record, and implements an evaluator that establishes the relation from evidence.
rationale: GAP-0008's restated first slice requires a second edge class that composes with the ContextManifest edge, and identified output content digesting as the shared prerequisite for both remaining directions.

The measurement that produced this conclusion inverted the packaging executor's expectation and is recorded in GAP-0008. 106 of 140 comparison artifacts already carry a governed produced_by seed, which looked like the cheap path; the reviewing executor established that the seeds are assertions rather than reconstructible evidence, which makes the digest the prerequisite rather than the alternative.

Response attribution was measured before scoping. All 106 seeded artifacts carry exactly two response sections, each with a model line naming an executor reference. The seed itself is artifact-level: it records that COMP-0140 was produced by two invocations without saying which response came from which. The section heading is a provider display name, OpenAI or Claude, while the record carries gpt-5.6-terra or claude-sonnet-5, and the mapping between them exists only in code. Attribution must therefore key on the model line, which is retained in the artifact, not on the heading.

The digest must be optional in the outcome block. Twenty-eight records carry an outcome and none carries a digest; requiring it would invalidate them. An absent digest yields unresolved, which is the same discipline the ancestry evaluator applies to an absent manifest reference.

This slice deliberately stops before composition. Once an established produced_by relation exists alongside the ContextManifest edge, invocation-to-invocation ancestry becomes derivable, and that is the first thing this project has built that could answer a C3-shaped question. Building the traversal in the same slice would mean the traversal and its two input edge classes were verified together, and the ContextManifest slice showed what happens when a completeness condition is assumed rather than falsified.
risk: The specific hazard is that an evaluator finds a seed, finds a response section, finds that text_chars agrees with its length, and reports the relation established. That is the current state of the evidence and it establishes nothing: any string of that length satisfies it. A weaker version of the same hazard is attribution by heading, which works today because provider display names and executor references happen to correspond, and would break silently the first time a provider is renamed or a third is added. Both are the pattern corrections A2 and A5 removed from ABS-0004: a record naming a property treated as establishment of the property.
scope: An optional output digest in the InvocationRecord outcome block, over the exact textual output returned by the provider, computed from the same value the comparison artifact incorporates.
Making a comparison artifact's response section attributable to a specific InvocationRecord, keyed on the retained model line rather than on the provider display heading.

A pure evaluator that, given an artifact and a record, recomputes the attributed response section's digest and reports whether it equals the record's retained output digest, returning unresolved with an enumerated reason otherwise.

The establishment condition for a produced_by relation: the record validates, carries an output digest, the artifact carries a seed naming that record, the attributed response section is identifiable, and its recomputed digest equals the retained one.
One deliberate run producing at least one established relation.
Tests implementing the falsification set in success_criteria.
success_criteria: POSITIVE. A record with an output digest, an artifact seeding produced_by for it, and an attributable response section that recomputes to that digest, yields an established relation.
NO DIGEST. A record with an outcome block and no output digest yields unresolved, not a failed relation. All 212 current records are this case.
DIGEST MISMATCH. A response section whose recomputed digest differs from the retained one yields unresolved and no established relation.
ALTERED RESPONSE. Editing one character of the response text in a retained artifact causes the relation to stop being established.
WRONG ATTRIBUTION. A seed naming a record whose model line matches no response section in the artifact yields unresolved rather than binding to whichever section happens to be present.
TWO RECORDS, TWO SECTIONS. An artifact with two seeded records establishes each against its own section and not against the other's.
SEED WITHOUT EVIDENCE. A seed for a record that carries no output digest yields unresolved, and the seed's authoritative flag is not read.
HEADING IS NOT ATTRIBUTION. Changing a response section's heading while leaving its model line intact does not change which record it is attributed to. This falsifies attribution by display name.
HISTORICAL SEEDS. The 106 existing seeds yield unresolved and are not promoted.
Each guard is mutation-tested: replacing it with behaviour that would establish a relation where the evaluator refuses causes a test to fail.
summary: Add a retained digest of each invocation's textual output and establish one invocation-to-artifact produced_by relation by recomputation. 106 comparison artifacts already carry governed produced_by seeds that assert the relation without retaining evidence to reconstruct it: the outcome block carries no content digest, and text_chars agreeing with a response length is satisfied by any string of that length. This slice adds the missing primitive, keys response attribution to the retained model line rather than the provider display heading, and implements an evaluator that derives the relation from evidence rather than reading the seed's authoritative flag. No traversal, no retrofit, no persistence decision.
title: Invocation output binding and produced_by establishment
